| Steps | PR | ISR* | TS% | CE% | N-H% (non-hacking/genuine) |

The paper's "99.5%" refers to ISR degradation (0.642 → 0.003 = -99.5%), not a "99.5% hacking rate." The actual hacking rate at 1000 steps is **100%** (0% non-hacking).
